fields.label: Printful catalog variant
fields.description: Set on the catalog row, not here. Map a Swell variant to a Printful catalog variant under Products → Printful catalog; that mapping is what the rate and submit paths follow

fields.label: Print technique
fields.description: Must match a key in the catalog item's Base cost by technique, e.g. dtg or embroidery. A technique the catalog row does not price cannot be costed or ordered

fields.label: Artwork URL
fields.description: Print file for a product that prints in one spot. Publicly reachable — Printful fetches it, so a signed or private URL fails at production time

fields.label: Artwork hash
fields.description: Content hash of the file above. The app carries it in the URL it sends Printful, which is what makes a changed design get refetched instead of the old one being reprinted. Change the artwork, change this

fields.label: Print placements
fields.description: For products that print in more than one spot. Listing any placement here replaces the single artwork above — the two are not combined. Every placement beyond the first adds its placement price to the item cost

fields.label: Placement
fields.description: Printful placement id, e.g. front, back, embroidery_chest_left

fields.label: Technique
fields.description: Overrides the product technique for this placement only. Leave empty to use it

fields.label: Artwork URL
fields.description: Print file for this placement. Required — a placement with no file is not printed, but Printful still produces and charges for the garment, so the order is stopped instead

fields.label: Artwork hash
fields.description: Content hash of this placement's print file

fields.label: Print area
fields.description: Printable geometry Printful reports for this product, used to size artwork before it is uploaded. Shape: { "width": 12, "height": 16, "dpi": 300 }, inches
